+"""Flag tokens inside a value (the tokenizer is the hot path)."""
+
+import re
+
+from lamina.lexer.core import Token
+
+
+def scan_flag(value: str, line: int, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> list[Token]:
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(value)
+    tokens: list[Token] = []
+    current_word: list[str] = []
+    start = 1
+    for column, ch in enumerate(value, start=1):
+        if re.match(r"[\s,]", ch):
+            if current_word:
+                tokens.append(Token("WORD", "".join(current_word), line, start))
+                current_word = []
+            continue
+        if not current_word:
+            start = column
+        current_word.append(ch)
+    if current_word:
+        tokens.append(Token("WORD", "".join(current_word), line, start))
+    return tokens
